entities.summary: Peru is a sovereign nation in South America, Americas. Its capital is Lima. Official languages include Spanish, Quechua, Aymara. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 34.4 million. Area: 1,285,216 km². Comprehensive index for Peru covering Norte Chico (oldest civilization in Americas, Caral ~3000 BCE), Chavín/Moche/Nazca/Wari cultures, Inca Empire (Tawantinsuyu, Cusco capital, greatest pre-Columbian empire), Pizarro conquest 1532-33 (Cajamarca/Atahualpa), Spanish Viceroyalty (Lima capital, richest colony silver/gold), independence 1821 (San Martín/Bolívar), War of the Pacific 1879-84 (lost to Chile, nitrates/Atacama), APRA foundation, military dictatorships, Velasco reforms 1968, Shining Path/Sendero Luminoso (Maoist insurgency 1980-2000, 70,000+ dead, Abimael Guzmán), MRTA (Japanese Embassy siege 1996-97), Fujimori authoritarianism/neoliberalism (1990-2000, daughter Keiko), corruption scandals (Odebrecht, Lava Jato), political instability (6 presidents 2016-23), and Machu Picchu global icon.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the site of the Inca Empire and a major center of pre-Columbian culture, Peru played a pivotal role in shaping the history of South America. The empire's legacy continues to influence the region's politics, society, and economy.
